chunks: Which the trusted spirit descended with

key_terms.الرُّوحُ: The Spirit, specifically referring to Angel Gabriel in the context of revelation
key_terms.الْأَمِينُ: The Trustworthy, denoting the reliability and fidelity of the angel

ai.seo_question: Who is the 'Trusted Spirit' that descended with the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Ar-Ruh al-Amin' (the Trustworthy Spirit) specifically identifies Jibril (Gabriel), emphasizing his role as the pure conduit of divine revelation who descended upon the Prophet Muhammad. This title underscores the reliability of the message and the spiritual purity of the messenger, distinguishing him from other angels or spirits in the context of receiving the Quran.
